name: compact
about: The phone map, normalised to the street band (Hero.css .hero__streets), which starts 48px under the subhead, is always `band` px tall, and runs to the hero's bottom edge. A uniform grid since October 8, 2026: three columns, at x 0.08, 0.5 and 0.92, and two rows 96px apart, the first along the band's top edge, so a block is 72px tall. Below the second row the columns run on off the bottom; a third row was taken out the same day to keep the hero compact. The two buttons sit in the top row's two blocks, one each, with a road on every side (`ctas`, the centre lines round them; Hero.jsx places the buttons from it). Nothing crosses the band's top edge, so the copy keeps its 48px clearance by construction. Traffic comes in and goes out at the sides and the bottom.
